items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Well Pichon, when I was working with him, he had Brass City and had Gordette and Raymond Brown.

ctx.x: How many years were you there? Two or three? One or two or three years. Well what about Pichon's band? Who did he have in his band?
Well Pichon, when I was working with him, he had Brass City and had Gordette and Raymond Brown.
Did you hear about Raymond Brown? I heard about him.
